findings.gap: Read-only observer can modify an operator-owned run and append tool records to it. PATCH uses facility read authorization only; tool run header checks facility but not stored actor ownership. Error recording is also facility-only.
findings.impact: A scoped observer can change durable summaries/outcomes or contaminate another actor run trace. This contradicts the server-enforced read-only/agent identity boundary even within the documented trusted-loopback prototype.

reproduction.environment: Temporary checkout reconstructed from immutable commit, isolated SQLite, synthetic service credentials; FastAPI TestClient without lifespan; no CSE/model calls

requests.doctor: stubbed readiness to avoid CSE access
requests.observed: doctor record added to operator-owned run.tool_calls

findings.minimum_fix: Bind run-writing/finalization and tool-call recording to the persisted actor owner (the current prototype can use fixed principal_role plus facility). Keep authorized reads separate. Rejected owner-mismatch attempts must not append into the target run in the error handler; log a separate security event if useful.
findings.product_reason: Facility users need trustworthy audit/agent results and an actual read-only role.
verification: Observer PATCH of an operator run returns 403 and leaves the entire run unchanged.
Observer tool request with another role run header returns 403 and does not append successful or denied tool records.
Owner calls/finalization still work; cross-facility denial remains enforced.
findings.implementation_state: fix in progress outside this frozen revision; not verified here

findings.gap: The virtual actuator ignores the accepted set_damper value: any acknowledged damper command causes a reported 100 percent damper and modeled recovery in exhaust_fault.
findings.impact: A valid zero/partial command can be reported as full opening and verified recovery. The model can choose a wrong action value yet receive a successful integration result, so command/ACK/observation verification does not establish the requested virtual behavior.

reproduction.environment: Immutable snapshot in isolated temporary store; acknowledged command seeded to isolate simulator mapping; publish replaced by an in-memory observation collector; no CSE/model calls

findings.minimum_fix: Preserve the acknowledged requested percentage in simulated actuator state and observations. Make modeled flow/recovery depend on that state and profile, with no unsupported physical efficacy claim. Alternatively reject unsupported values explicitly rather than acknowledging different behavior.
findings.product_reason: Even a labeled simulation must faithfully execute the declared command contract and retain unsuccessful action outcomes.
verification: Real service/CSE tests for accepted 0, 50 and 100 percent commands retain the exact value in command, virtual ACK and later observations.
A zero or insufficient partial action does not fabricate recovery.
The 100 percent positive case and explicit no_recovery case still distinguish successful command/ACK from subsequent observed recovery.
Repeated requests remain idempotent and post-ACK samples are distinct.
findings.main_decision: accepted by main; independently also found by Team 1
findings.implementation_state: fix in progress outside this frozen revision; not verified here

Pending-run restart coverage should be assessed against the specific restart evidence; completed lifecycle rehearsal alone is not all continuity behavior.

No Codex model turn, desktop UI or human-first-use rehearsal is captured. Do not promote PASS_HOST_MCP to those claims. Team 2/main owns the combined guided-onboarding acceptance; this review does not invent an additional mandatory desktop test.
gate_assessment.S3-G2: Existing hosted-model positive/no-recovery/stale traces support actual shared MCP/service/CSE execution. Rerun or replay affected scenarios on the corrected code before closing trust-sensitive gates; do not relabel the old captures as new-revision live runs.
gate_assessment.S3-G3: Shared SQLite reservations, concurrency, retries, unknown usage charging and restart preservation pass independent unit checks; actual negative model traces exist. Run-owner and simulated actuator defects remain blockers.
gate_assessment.S3-G4: Requires all four teams and independent close-out of accepted fixes; not passed by this report.

The later application acceptance hashes do match the frozen implementation. Preserve exact provenance and record a change-impact/replay bridge rather than treating historical live captures as a final-source live rerun.
